folded.description: the date files fully consolidated this time, which may be git rm'd (only the ones given this time)

destinations.description: the files the content went into (memory/reference/<topic>.md or STATE.md); list one too when the content was already there

dropped.description: the content not kept and why (process noise / duplicate / overturned by a newer record), in the content language named in the prompt; an empty string when everything was kept

kept.description: the date files given this time that cannot be deleted yet, and why

reason.description: why, in the content language named in the prompt

corrections.description: statements in reference/ or STATE.md changed because a newer record overturned or replaced them

evidence_file.description: the file it is based on (usually a newer date file)

evidence_quote.description: a sentence copied verbatim from evidence_file that shows the change is right

summary.description: what was done this time, at most three sentences, for a person spot-checking; in the content language named in the prompt
